# gtfs-mcp - Full LLM Reference

Generated: 2026-08-03

FastMCP 3.4 server for downloading, parsing, and serving GTFS (General Transit
Feed Specification) schedule data, with a FastAPI REST API, 7 MCP tools, and a
React webapp (web_sota/).

## Ports

| Port | Service |
|------|---------|
| 10913 | Backend (FastAPI + MCP streamable HTTP at `/mcp`) |
| 10912 | Frontend (Vite dev server, proxies `/api` `/mcp` `/health` -> 10913) |

## MCP Tools (7)

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `add_feed(feed_id, url, update_interval=3600, force_update=False)` | Add/update a GTFS feed by downloading its zip |
| `list_feeds()` | List registered feeds with status |
| `get_departures(feed_id, stop_id, route_id=None, limit=5)` | Upcoming departures for a stop |
| `get_stop_info(feed_id, stop_id)` | Details for one stop |
| `find_stops(feed_id, query, limit=10)` | Case-insensitive search by name/code/id |
| `status()` | Server + feed count status |
| `shutdown()` | Graceful server shutdown |

All tools return `{success, message, ...}` dicts. Mutating: add_feed, shutdown.

## REST Endpoints

| Endpoint | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `GET /health`, `/api/health`, `/api/v1/health` | Liveness: status/version/uptime/tool_count |
| `GET /api/status`, `/api/v1/status` | Status with uptime + tool count |
| `GET /api/capabilities` | Feature discovery for the webapp |
| `GET /api/skills`, `GET /skill/{name}` | Skill manifest + SKILL.md content |
| `GET /api/llm/providers`, `/api/llm/discover` | Ollama/LM Studio probe + model lists |
| `POST /api/llm/chat/stream` | NDJSON streaming chat proxy to Ollama |
| `POST /api/llm/chat` | Non-streaming chat completion |
| `GET /api/logs`, `/api/logs/stats`, `/api/logs/export`, `DELETE /api/logs` | Ring-buffer log API |
| `GET /api/v1/diagnostics` | Tool list + system info (CUA-NSIS smoke) |
| `GET/POST /v1/feeds`, `GET /v1/stops/search`, `GET /v1/stops/{id}`, `GET /v1/stops/{id}/departures` | GTFS domain API |
| `GET /mcp` | MCP streamable HTTP transport |

## Environment Variables

| Var | Default | Purpose |
|-----|---------|---------|
| `GTFS_MCP_PORT` | 10913 | HTTP port |
| `GTFS_MCP_HOST` | 127.0.0.1 | Bind host |
| `GTFS_MCP_LOG_LEVEL` | INFO | Log level |
| `GTFS_MCP_DEFAULT_FEED_URL` | Wiener Linien GTFS zip | Default feed (Vienna, id `default`) loaded at startup |
| `GTFS_MCP_DATA_DIR` | `data` | Feed data + `gtfs_mcp.db` persistence store |
| `GTFS_MCP_DISCOVERY__TRANSITFEEDS_API_KEY` | - | Feed discovery key |
| `MCP_TRANSPORT` | stdio | stdio/http/sse (dual transport) |
| `MCP_PORT` / `PORT` | - | run_server.py: set -> HTTP mode |

## Persistence

Parsed feed rows are stored in SQLite (`<data_dir>/gtfs_mcp.db`) as JSON
blobs keyed by feed + table (order preserved). On restart `load_all_from_db`
restores every stored feed into memory - no re-download unless the feed is
expired, force-updated, or moved to a different URL. The Vienna (Wiener
Linien) feed is the default and is loaded as feed id `default` on first run.

## Architecture

- `src/gtfs_mcp/main.py` - FastAPI app (CORS fleet regex, health, capabilities,
  logs, llm proxy, diagnostics), mounts `mcp.http_app()` at `/mcp`
- `src/gtfs_mcp/__init__.py` - FastMCP instance + lifespan (init/cleanup service)
- `src/gtfs_mcp/services/gtfs_service.py` - the 7 MCP tools (Annotated+Field,
  Return Format + Examples docstrings, dialogic returns)
- `src/gtfs_mcp/core/gtfs_parser.py` - GTFS zip/CSV parsing, calendar logic
- `src/gtfs_mcp/core/feed_manager.py` - async download + update lifecycle
- `src/gtfs_mcp/transport.py` - dual transport; HTTP mode uses uvicorn.Server on
  `mcp.http_app()` with CORSMiddleware (never run_http_async)
- `run_server.py` - PyInstaller entry: `MCP_PORT` set -> HTTP, else stdio
- `web_sota/` - React 19 + Vite 7 + Tailwind 3 + lucide-react webapp
  (Dashboard with live health KPIs, Chat skill-first, Settings LLM, Logging)

## Troubleshooting

- Webapp shows Offline: check backend on 10913 (`uv run -m gtfs_mcp --http
  --port 10913`), then `/health`.
- CORS errors on Tailscale/LAN: the fleet regex covers `*.ts.net`, LAN and CGNAT
  ranges; localhost and tauri://localhost always allowed.
- Frozen backend (NSIS) exits immediately: run `native/binaries/gtfs-mcp-backend-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe` with `MCP_PORT` set and read stderr.
